name: controlled-v3-development
description: Development compatibility corpus for target-inspection and backend preflight. These cases were inspected while extending parser support and are not a held-out performance set.

targets.label: circomlib Decoder vulnerable
targets.input_assumptions: inp is a canonical BN128 field element. Decoder(4) is defined for every field element; no narrower caller precondition is imposed.

known_defects.location: circuits/multiplexer.circom:80-94; witness-only output selection permits out[i]=0 when inp=i
known_defects.local_reproduction: Exact vulnerable source and Decoder(4) wrapper compile under the frozen development environment; backend discovery is not established by this annotation.
known_defects.reachability: The public metadata's original entrypoint is the same direct wrapper; a larger project caller is not established.

targets.label: circomlib Decoder fixed comparator
targets.input_assumptions: inp is a canonical BN128 field element. Decoder(4) is defined for every field element; no narrower caller precondition is imposed.

targets.label: UniRep BigLessThan vulnerable
targets.input_assumptions: in[0] and in[1] are canonical BN128 field elements interpreted by their canonical integer representatives in [0, p-1].

known_defects.local_reproduction: Exact vulnerable source and BigLessThan() wrapper compile under the frozen development environment; backend discovery is not established by this annotation.
known_defects.reachability: The public repository supplies packages/circuits/generated/bigComparators.circom as an original entrypoint; broader production-caller impact is not established.

targets.label: UniRep BigLessThan fixed comparator
targets.input_assumptions: in[0] and in[1] are canonical BN128 field elements interpreted by their canonical integer representatives in [0, p-1].
